notes.title: Update 1 - Japanese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hungarian
notes.notes:
Hey!

The game has been translated to 4 new languages : Japanese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Hungarian. Only possible thanks to the translators, who volunteered to translate it!

[list]
[*] Japanese by Youge(ようげ), ウオザトヲレス | Wallace Uozato, ゲーム実況者 スロースタートのやつ
[*] Spanish by José Fernando Gracia
[*] Brazilian Portuguese by Isaac Magalhaes
[/list]

------

This update also contains a few fixes and quality of life improvements:

[list]
[*] A possible fix for the bookworm achievement. It should work but please report if it is still buggy.
[*] A small page counter which shows how many pages the player has found, and the maximum available pages.
[*] Some small typos fixed.
[/list]

There will be more language updates in the future, and also a Mac build.
Thank you for all your support!

Balazs

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

- Some players miss what actually happened when they got the Entomologist achievement. Now in order to get it you need to [spoiler] keep looking with the magnifier at that specific part of the sculpture for at least 2 seconds. [/spoiler]
- Fixed a minor typo.

Please report any bugs or technical problems.

Balazs

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

- Fixed fps not having a limit. Now it should match the refresh rate of the screen.
- Fixed the aspect ratio problem. Now the game should be playable on all aspect ratios.

Please report any bugs or technical problems!

Balazs
